theme_details: Dominant dark cinematic hero + transformation sections. Light sections for architectural & premium showcase. Do NOT invent new colors.

typography.details: Use Cabinet Grotesk for cinematic, premium architectural headings. Use Manrope for high-legibility tech details. Apply tracking-tighter to H1/H2.

layouts_and_grids.general: Bento-style grids, asymmetrical columns (e.g. 4-col + 8-col). Avoid standard symmetrical 4-column cards.
layouts_and_grids.spacing: Generous spacing. Use Tailwind classes like py-24, py-32 for section padding.

visual_enhancers.dark_sections: Subtle noise/grain overlays, abstract point cloud tech meshes, deep shadows, 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1) borders.
visual_enhancers.light_sections: Architectural feel, crisp edges, subtle rgba(0,0,0,0.05) borders, solid background instead of glassmorphism if it holds data.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal using Framer Motion (initial y: 100%, clip-path mask, staggered 0.1s).
motion.transformation_sequence: Sticky scroll container (position: sticky or framer-motion useScroll). User scrolls to progress through 5 phases. Lightweight CSS opacity/transform crossfading for background images and text instead of heavy WebGL.

components.Navigation: Sticky, transparent to solid on scroll with backdrop-blur-xl. Contains logo, links, CTA.
components.Hero: Full-screen 100vh. Dark theme. Kinetic typography. Subtle point cloud background with #020203 vignette.
components.The_Transformation: Scroll-driven visual. Sticky container. 5 stages (Physical Space -> Capture -> Digital Twin -> Immersive -> Marketing -> Conversion). Background changes state.
components.Capabilities: Light theme. Interactive pattern (e.g., sticky side tabs or vertical accordion). NOT a 4-col card grid. When one is active, visual shifts.
components.Project_Showcase: Light theme. Asymmetrical bento grid or horizontal scroll. Project categories: Property, Hospitality, Venues, Developments.
components.Who_We_Help: Dark theme. 6 interactive segments. Hovering one segment reveals use cases and dims others.
components.Conversion_Funnel: Multi-step interactive qualification flow. App-like step-by-step UI, progress bar using brand gradient.
components.Credibility_Band: Dark theme. Slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee) with "POWERED BY NOVO REPERIO".
components.Footer: Massive typography for final CTA, stark architectural structure, generous spacing.
components.Floating_WhatsApp: Fixed bottom-right button with pulse animation, z-50.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Implement glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly forbidden).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Avoid generic WordPress look, property portal styles, or boring service card grids.
Do NOT invent statistics, pricing, testimonials, or project details.
Ensure dark to light theme transitions feel intentional.
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lenis (or @studio-freight/lenis), lucide-react, react-fast-marquee.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gradients or dark backgrounds meets APCA standards.
accessibility.motion: Ensure scroll animations perform well and do not hijack standard scroll completely.
